description: This Java class provides functionality for parsing JSON values from various inputs such as strings and readers. It offers methods to create parser functions, handle exceptions, and utilize external libraries for JSON parsing.

classes.name: JsonValueParser
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for parsing JsonValue objects from strings and readers, supporting customizable handlers and exception handling.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns a Consumer<String> that parses a JSON string using a specified handler.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns a Function<String, JsonValue> to parse JSON strings into JsonValue instances.

methods.name: fromReader
methods.description: Provides a Function<Reader, JsonValue> to parse JSON values from a Reader.
